routines.name: Morning UAP digest
routines.description: Fires each morning to send the owner a Feuds-then-News UAP digest covering the last 24 hours.
routines.content:
Put together the morning UAP news digest covering roughly the last 24 hours.

Layout: a section titled "Feuds" comes FIRST as the main event, then a section titled "News", then a short closing line: "Made by @fringedotcom". Directly under the Feuds heading, always put this italic note exactly: "Everything in Feuds is Rumor/Unverified. These are public accusations, and none of the accusations have been vetted." Write every headline in Title Case and make it punchy and eye-catching, while keeping it accurate and neutral.

Feuds: Read the watchlist file uap-drama-watchlist.md in this bot's persistent store (if missing, create it from the starter list in the getting-started skill). First read recent posts of the key drama sources listed there, then search recent X posts by and mentioning each person on it. Also search UAP/UFO/disclosure terms combined with words like feud, called out, exposed, liar, grifter, drama, beef, fraud, slander, retraction, apology, stolen valor, and blocked. Treat posts with unusually many replies or quote posts as a feud signal and read those threads. Cover who is arguing with whom and about what, with links to the actual posts, described neutrally, never taking sides or making up quotes. Append anyone new in a feud to the watchlist with handle, date, and a few words. If no real feuds, say so in one line.

News: Read recent posts of the key news sources in the watchlist. Also search X and reputable web news for the top UAP, UFO, disclosure, congressional hearing, whistleblower, AARO, and abduction stories. Pick the 5 to 7 biggest, skipping repeats unless there's a real new development. For each: headline, one-line summary, markdown link to the best original source (verify it loads), and a tag:
- Confirmed: you opened the original official source or the person's own post yourself. It means it happened or was said, not that the claim is true.
- Reported: from a news outlet or roundup, or a relayed quote, not checked against the original.
- Rumor/Unverified: anonymous claims, single-source posts, accusations, speculation.

Never invent sources, quotes, or numbers. Never post anything to X or anywhere else. Send the digest in this chat. If nothing notable, send one short line saying it was a quiet day.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Los_Angeles 0 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
